# sendgrid_google_analytics_settings (Resource)

Google Analytics tracking adds [UTM parameters](https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/ui/account-and-settings/tracking#google-analytics) to the links in your emails, so you can see in Google Analytics which emails brought visitors to your site.

SendGrid stores one Google Analytics setting per account, so declaring more than one of this resource for the same account will make them fight over that single setting. Destroying this resource leaves the setting on the account as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendgrid_google_analytics_settings" "example" {
  enabled      = true
  utm_source   = "sendgrid"
  utm_medium   = "email"
  utm_campaign = "newsletter"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if Google Analytics tracking is enabled or disabled. Defaults to `false`, so omitting it turns Google Analytics tracking off for the account.
- `utm_campaign` (String) The value set as `utm_campaign` in the links. Defaults to `""`, so omitting it clears the value on the account.
- `utm_content` (String) The value set as `utm_content` in the links. Defaults to `""`, so omitting it clears the value on the account.
- `utm_medium` (String) The value set as `utm_medium` in the links. Defaults to `""`, so omitting it clears the value on the account.
- `utm_source` (String) The value set as `utm_source` in the links. Defaults to `""`, so omitting it clears the value on the account.
- `utm_term` (String) The value set as `utm_term` in the links. Defaults to `""`, so omitting it clears the value on the account.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
% terraform import sendgrid_google_analytics_settings.example ""
```
